name: dynamic_on_error_skip
orchestration:
effects:
  - name: guarded
    type: dynamic
    on_error: skip
    effects:
      - name: bad
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: 'not json'}
expected_stderr: WARNING: Dynamic 'guarded': guarded.bad: json: parse failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0); on_error=skip, continuing with the next effect

name: dynamic_on_error_continue
orchestration:
effects:
  - name: guarded
    type: dynamic
    on_error: continue
    effects:
      - name: bad
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: 'not json'}
expected_stderr: WARNING: Dynamic 'guarded': guarded.bad: json: parse failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0); on_error=continue, continuing with the next effect

name: dynamic_finally_failed_degraded
orchestration:
effects:
  - name: cleanup_case
    type: dynamic
    on_error: continue
    effects:
      - name: body
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: '{}'}
    finally:
      - name: cleanup
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: 'not json'}
expected_stderr: WARNING: Dynamic 'cleanup_case': finally failed (cleanup_case.cleanup: json: parse failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)); on_error=continue, continuing with the next effect

name: dynamic_cleanup_also_failed
orchestration:
effects:
  - name: cleanup_case
    type: dynamic
    on_error: continue
    effects:
      - name: body
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: 'not json'}
    finally:
      - name: cleanup
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: 'also not json'}
expected_stderr:
WARNING: Dynamic 'cleanup_case': cleanup in 'finally' also failed (cleanup_case.cleanup: json: parse failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)) after the original failure (cleanup_case.body: json: parse failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0))
WARNING: Dynamic 'cleanup_case': cleanup_case.body: json: parse failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0); on_error=continue, continuing with the next effect

name: conditional_on_error_continue
orchestration:
effects:
  - name: gate
    type: if
    on_error: continue
    if:
      mode: cel
      expr: "state.prime.missing.value == 1"
      strict: true
    then:
      - name: yes_branch
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: '{}'}
    else:
      - name: no_branch
        type: tool
        provider: json
        params: {mode: parse, input: '{}'}
expected_stderr: WARNING: Conditional 'gate': condition failed (CEL expression 'state.prime.missing.value == 1' reads unset state path 'state.prime.missing.value' and is marked strict.); on_error=continue, taking the else branch
